title: The Lens Turns
summary: Jecia turns the Night Watcher's Lens from a bounty reward into the first explicit World Master arc reward: a visible item effect tied to her personal journey state.

beats.label: The Lens Resonates
beats.description: The lens reacts to Jecia's recent fights and marks Defias activity as the next pressure point.

beats.label: Thin The Bandits
beats.description: Jecia drives back a small Defias group so the item reward has a concrete story beat.

beats.label: Bind The Reward
beats.description: The reward is recorded in the character journey spine as a reusable eligibility fact for future powers and scenes.

quest.title: Jecia: The Lens Turns
quest.quest_description: The Night Watcher's Lens pulls Jecia's attention back toward Defias movement near Elwynn. Thin their numbers, then return to Guard Thomas.
quest.request_items_text: Drive back 4 Defias Bandits, then report to Guard Thomas.
quest.offer_reward_text: Guard Thomas studies the lens and nods. Whatever is guiding you, it has teeth. Keep it close.

conversation_steering.body: Prefer future rewards that expose their hidden server behavior through visible item, aura, debuff, tooltip, or combat-message state.

prompt_queue.body: Offer the next Jecia branch as either a companion upgrade, an item-granted alternate ability, or a live scene intervention.

notes: This is the first Arc + Reward Factory V1 scenario: a short personal arc, a fresh quest slot, and a visible managed item reward.
